doc.title: Leslie Gourse interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996

title: Joe Williams's group and his guitar playing
summary: They try to recall Williams's guitarist; Gourse reveals he plays a bit of guitar, which he never mentioned to her.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Joe has a fine group right now of musicians he usually works with, which includes a young guitarist that — let’s see his piano player is Norman Simmons, and let’s see if I can remember the guitar player.
It’s not Howard Alden right now is it?
No, it’s not Howard Alden. And since I brought it up I should be able to remember the name. I’ll remember it in a moment. But he depends a lot – I’m sorry I can’t remember.
Yeah, a little bit. At least a little bit. I don’t know how much. You know writing this whole book he never mentioned to me he played guitar.
